domain.text: GitHub board-card status reconciliation and issue-close behavior

impressions.text: The work addressed keeping board-card status in sync with issue closure and adding mismatch reporting and repair.
The worker reported passing formatting, lint, typecheck, tests, build, smoke, and knip checks, with CI green after the final revision.
Review caught draft cards being treated as open, missing Progress clearing, and unreadable mismatch output; the worker addressed these with regression coverage.
The orchestrator marked the change ready for owner review, and the PR was merged; the thread does not report a stop or escalation.

roundCauses.text: Round 1 requested fixes for draft-card handling, clearing Progress on issue close, and readable mismatch output.
Round 2 requested an explicit Progress-clear operation and a regression test because the prior revision still left Progress set.
